surah.personality_summary: Unique Qur'anic surah of 52 ayat revealed in Mecca, possessing its distinct thematic core, atmosphere, and rhetorical progression.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Qalam (The Pen) is the 68th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 52 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ن ۚ وَالْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ن ۚ والقلم وما يسطرون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Nun By the pen! By all they write

ayahs.translation_saheeh: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Your Lord’s grace does not make you [Prophet] a madman

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: you will have a never-ending reward––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, you are of a great moral character
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: truly you have a strong character––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So you will see and they will see
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and soon you will see, as will they

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: which of you is afflicted with madness

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان ربك هو اعلم بمن ضل عن سبيله وهو اعلم بالمهتدين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is rightly guided

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then do not obey the deniers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So do not yield to those who deny the truth––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they want you to compromise with them and then they will compromise with you––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: do not yield to any contemptible swearer

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: to any backbiter, slander-monger

ayahs.translation_saheeh: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: or hinderer of good, to anyone who is sinful, aggressive

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: coarse, and on top of all that, an imposter

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Just because he has wealth and sons

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذا تتلى عليه اياتنا قال اساطير الاولين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: when our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘These are just ancient fables.’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: We will brand him upon the snout
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall brand him on the snout

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَاهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَا أَصْحَابَ الْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا بلوناهم كما بلونا اصحاب الجنة اذ اقسموا ليصرمنها مصبحين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have tried them as We tried the owners of a certain garden, who swore that they would harvest its fruits in the morning

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Without making exception
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and made no allowance [for the Will of God]

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَائِفٌ مِنْ رَبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَائِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فطاف عليها طائف من ربك وهم نائمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: a disaster from your Lord struck the garden as they slept

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And it became as though reaped
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and by morning it was stripped bare, a desolate land

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they called one another at morning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Still they called each other at daybreak

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَنِ اغْدُوا عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَارِمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان اغدوا على حرثكم ان كنتم صارمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Go early to your field if you wish to gather all its fruits,’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: So they set out, while lowering their voices
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and went off, whispering

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَنْ لَا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا الْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِسْكِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان لا يدخلنها اليوم عليكم مسكين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Make sure no poor person enters the garden today!’––

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they left early, bent on their purpose

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but when they saw the garden, they said, ‘We must have lost our way

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Rather, we have been deprived
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: No- we are ruined!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ لَكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال اوسطهم الم اقل لكم لولا تسبحون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The wisest of them said, ‘Did I not say to you, “Will you not glorify God?”’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا سُبْحَانَ رَبِّنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا سبحان ربنا انا كنا ظالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they said, ‘Glory be to God, Our Lord! Truly, we were doing wrong!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then they approached one another, blaming each other
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and then they turned to each other in mutual reproach

ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا طَاغِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا يا ويلنا انا كنا طاغين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They said, ‘Alas for us! We have done terrible wrong

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَا أَنْ يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهَا إِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَاغِبُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: عسى ربنا ان يبدلنا خيرا منها انا الى ربنا راغبون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but maybe our Lord will give us something better in its place: we truly turn to Him in hope.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَذَٰلِكَ الْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كذلك العذاب ۖ ولعذاب الاخرة اكبر ۚ لو كانوا يعلمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Such is the punishment [in this life], but greater still is the punishment in the Hereafter, if only they knew

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان للمتقين عند ربهم جنات النعيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There will be Gardens of bliss for those who are mindful of God

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Should We treat those who submit to Us as We treat those who do evil

ayahs.translation_saheeh: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: What is the matter with you? On what basis do you judge

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do you have a Scripture that tells you

ayahs.translation_saheeh: That indeed for you is whatever you choose
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: that you will be granted whatever you choose

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَانٌ عَلَيْنَا بَالِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام لكم ايمان علينا بالغة الى يوم القيامة ۙ ان لكم لما تحكمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Have you received from Us solemn oaths, binding to the Day of Resurrection, that you will get whatever you yourselves decide

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Ask them [Prophet] which of them will guarantee this

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُ فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَاءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا بِشُرَكَائِهِمْ إِنْ كَانُوا صَادِقِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام لهم شركاء فلياتوا بشركائهم ان كانوا صادقين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they have ‘partners’ [besides God]? Let them produce their ‘partners’, if what they say is true

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقࣲ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم يكشف عن ساق ويدعون الى السجود فلا يستطيعون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: On the Day when matters become dire, they will be invited to prostrate themselves but will be prevented from doing so

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةࣱۖ وَقَدۡ كَانُواْ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمۡ سَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: خَاشِعَةً أَبْصَارُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى السُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَالِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: خاشعة ابصارهم ترهقهم ذلة ۖ وقد كانوا يدعون الى السجود وهم سالمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and their eyes will be downcast and they will be overwhelmed with shame: they were invited to prostrate themselves when they were safe [but refused]

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَذَرۡنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِۖ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَذَرْنِي وَمَنْ يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فذرني ومن يكذب بهذا الحديث ۖ سنستدرجهم من حيث لا يعلمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So [Prophet] leave those who reject this revelation to Me: We shall lead them on, step by step, in ways beyond their knowledge

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I will allow them more time, for My plan is powerful

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُمْ مِنْ مَغْرَمٍ مُثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام تسالهم اجرا فهم من مغرم مثقلون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do you demand some reward from them that would burden them with debt

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they have knowledge of the unseen that enables them to write it down

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُنْ كَصَاحِبِ الْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تكن كصاحب الحوت اذ نادى وهو مكظوم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: do not be like the man in the whale who called out in distress

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَوْلَا أَنْ تَدَارَكَهُ نِعْمَةٌ مِنْ رَبِّهِ لَنُبِذَ بِالْعَرَاءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لولا ان تداركه نعمة من ربه لنبذ بالعراء وهو مذموم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: if his Lord’s grace had not reached him, he would have been left, abandoned and blameworthy, on the barren shore

ayahs.translation_saheeh: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but his Lord chose him and made him one of the Righteous

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنْ يَكَادُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَارِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُ لَمَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان يكاد الذين كفروا ليزلقونك بابصارهم لما سمعوا الذكر ويقولون انه لمجنون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The disbelievers almost strike you down with their looks when they hear the Quran. They say, ‘He must be mad!’

ayahs.translation_saheeh: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but truly it is nothing other than a Reminder for all peoples
